title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada (\"budget fishing\").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas (\"Overview Demos\") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.


Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.


Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

title: Pessoa Estagiária em Inteligência de Negócios
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Apoiar nos processos de Gestão da Inadimplência (recebimento de informações dos shoppings, consolidação de dados e indicadores, análises pontuais solicitadas pela Diretoria)

  • Atuar de forma pró-ativa com as demais áreas (Jurídico, CSC, Régua de Cobrança, Faturamento, TI, Contas a Receber, Fornecedores e etc)

title: Supervisor de Enfermagem - Unidade de Internação Pediátrica Oncológica
description:
Requisitos:

-COREN ativo e dentro da validade;

-Necessário boa vivência com gestão de equipes, experiência na área assistencial, com oncologia pediátrica.




Atividades:


- Tomar ciência, diariamente, das orientações constantes do livro de Ordens e Ocorrências e demais anotações, a fim de tomar ciência das intercorrências ocorridas no plantão diurno possibilitando dar continuidade aos tratamentos dos pacientes;


- Com base na escala mensal de funcionários, recebida da Gerência de Enfermagem, conferir diariamente a presença, atrasos, licença médicas e trocas de plantão realizado pelos funcionários, anotando no livro de ordens e ocorrência as divergências encontradas;


- Inspecionar, diariamente, os Setores de Enfermagem da Unidade, avaliando a qualidade de assistência prestada e identificando a necessidade de utilização de equipamentos e remanejamento de pessoal para prestação de atendimento adequado, bem como se as equipes estão utilizando o uniforme padrão da Unidade, com seus respectivos equipamentos de segurança;


- Orientar as atividades desenvolvidas pelos Enfermeiros Plantonistas, na realização de suas atividades diárias, bem como observando e orientando aspectos de desvio de comportamentos, a fim de corrigir os problemas com colaboradores no seu turno;


- Atender os clientes e seus acompanhantes, quando solicitado, esclarecendo as dúvidas apresentadas, bem como providenciando a solução aos superiores de plantão, caso o assunto fuja dos limites de sua autonomia;


- Garantir o cumprimento das Instruções Operacionais Técnicas e Administrativas do serviço noturno como: preparo pré-operatório, pré-exames, transferência de pacientes, conferência de material/medicação, requisição de farmácia, registrando as intercorrências e dificuldades encontradas no plantão no livro de Ordens e Ocorrências;


- Apoiar a Recepção de Internação propondo e encaminhando soluções inerentes a liberação de quarto ou leito, a fim de facilitar o processo de internação de novos ou transferências internas de pacientes;


- Acionar, quando necessário, o Setor de Engenharia Clínica, visando providenciar o reparo de equipamentos defeituosos na Unidade, durante seu plantão;


- Acompanhar e orientar situações de acidentes de trabalho ocorridos no seu turno, encaminhando os acidentados ao Setor de Emergência, bem como comunicando ao Setor de Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho as ocorrências;


- Intermediar situações que necessitem de auxílio a outras Unidades da Rede, obtendo autorização superior para os casos de: empréstimo de materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalares, uso de autoclave e etc;


- Participar da elaboração de manuais de rotinas ou POPs, junto com as áreas de CCIH, Qualidade e Educação Continuada, a fim de contribuir para a implantação de processo de melhores práticas de assistência hospitalar;


- Testar materiais e equipamentos novos e responder pareceres técnicos enviados pelos setores de padronização e engenharia clínica respectivamente para análise e decisão sobre a utilização/aquisição.

200h - 07h às 16h.



- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

The Methodical Group (TMG) is a global provider of IT services, consulting, and specialized staffing solutions, operating with a systematic and quality-driven approach for over 25 years. title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.




Important Candidate Notice : On January 9, 2026, CommScope finalized the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment, which included the CommScope name and brand, to Amphenol Corporation. The remaining businesses — Access Networks Solutions (now rebranded as Aurora Networks ) and RUCKUS Networks have been unified under the new parent company, renamed as Vistance Networks . The role being advertised is part of RUCKUS Networks.


Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce OEM Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce-based products using Salesforce’s OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) platform. This role requires deep expertise in Salesforce application development, second-generation managed packages, and modern Salesforce development practices, including a thorough and practical understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits and how to design within them.


Along with our partner, we are seeking a candidate who combines strong engineering skills with deep Salesforce administrator-level knowledge to deliver secure, performant, and upgrade-safe managed solutions deployed across multiple customer orgs.


Key Responsibilities:

Salesforce OEM & Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce OEM solutions using second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Build scalable, upgrade-safe features aligned with Salesforce OEM and ISV best practices
  • Implement application logic using Apex, SOQL, and SOSL, with careful consideration of platform constraints
  • Design solutions that efficiently operate within Salesforce governor limits, including limits related to CPU time, heap size, queries, DML, and concurrent execution
  • Develop modern user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and the Lightning framework
  • Ensure package versioning, dependency management, and release processes follow Salesforce standards


Platform Configuration & Administration

  • Apply deep Salesforce admin knowledge to design effective, maintainable configurations that complement custom code
  • Build and maintain Flows (record-triggered, screen flows, orchestration), ensuring automation is performant and governor-limit aware
  • Configure and manage profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, and sharing rules
  • Design and maintain page layouts, Lightning Record Pages, and UI customizations
  • Evaluate and balance declarative vs. programmatic solutions to minimize technical debt and reduce risk of governor limit violations


Source Control & DevOps

  • Use Git for source control, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows
  • Collaborate within CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments (e.g., scratch orgs, packaging orgs, automated testing)
  • Support release management processes for managed packages across multiple versions and customers


Quality & Collaboration

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Service Cloud Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58531



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar funcionalidades em Apex (triggers, services, batch/queueable/schedulable), garantindo bulkification, testes e respeito aos limites da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver Lightning Web Components (LWC) com arquitetura limpa, performance, consumo de dados via LDS/wire e chamadas @AuraEnabled.
  • Construir e manter integrações (REST/SOAP): callouts com Named Credentials, autenticação (OAuth/JWT), tratamento de erros e observabilidade (logs/monitoramento).
  • Atuar no ecossistema de Service Cloud & Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots), integrando fluxos de atendimento e automações.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debug logs, trace flags, Event Monitoring) e otimizações de performance/consultas.
  • Versionar e implantar com SFDX + Git (branching, code review, qualidade de código).
  • Garantir segurança e compliance (FLS/CRUD, compartilhamento, transações) e produzir documentação técnica de suporte às entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Forte experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce (Pleno/Sênior) com foco em Service Cloud.
  • Domínio de Apex, SOQL/SOSL, padrões assíncronos e testes unitários (qualidade e cobertura).
  • Experiência com LWC (JS moderno, componentização, comunicação com Apex).
  • Vivência com Digital Engagement (Chat/Messaging/WhatsApp), incluindo implementação técnica e integração com processos de atendimento.
  • Integrações via API REST/SOAP em Apex (Named Credentials, serialização JSON/XML, tratamento de exceções).
  • Troubleshooting e análise de logs em ambientes produtivos e sandboxes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de governor limits e estratégias de otimização.
  • Prática com Salesforce DX e Git (pull requests, code review).
  • Certificações: Platform Developer I

CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.

100% remoto.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven work experience with cold calling or phone sales.
  • Proven work experience with text messaging/emailing in English.

  • Excellent communication skills, including listening and facing conflict head-on.
  • Excellent at building rapport.
  • Willing to work in a fast-paced environment and rapidly grow.
  • Open to learning new processes in cold calling/seller outreach.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas

title: Mainframe System Engineer
description:
Mainframe System Engineer

Location – Brazil Remote



Job Overview:


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Mandatory Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:
  • IBM OMEGAMON for Storage
  • IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm
  • IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)
  • IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)
  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems
  • CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).
  • CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).
  • IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation, operational considerations).
  • CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Atendente comercial
description:
Título da vaga: Atendimento Comercial (PJ) | Fotografia Pet

Modelo:  Híbrido – Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Regime: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

Horário:  seg–sab, 9h–17h 

Início:  Imediato

​Descrição da Empresa:

A Pedaço de Céu Foto Pet é um estúdio especializado em fotografia pet e família multiespécie, criado para transformar vínculos reais em memórias que atravessam o tempo.

Acreditamos que cada pet tem uma essência única e que o amor entre tutores e seus companheiros merece ser registrado com sensibilidade, calma e respeito.

Nosso trabalho vai além de “fotos bonitas”: entregamos uma experiência afetiva, conduzida com acolhimento e um olhar atento aos detalhes, ao comportamento e ao conforto do animal.

Cada ensaio é planejado de forma personalizada, para que o resultado traduza verdade, conexão e história. 


Objetivo da função

Ser a pessoa responsável por converter leads em sessões agendadas , com atendimento rápido, consultivo e com follow-up consistente, fazendo prospecção ativa com a base de clientes recorrentes.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atender leads via WhatsApp/Instagram/Telefone com rapidez e clareza.
  • Fazer qualificação (perfil do tutor, tipo de pet, objetivo, disponibilidade, urgência).
  • Apresentar pacotes/condições e conduzir a negociação até o fechamento.
  • Agendar sessões e coordenar agenda com a equipe desde o início até a entrega final das fotos.
  • Registrar tudo em CRM/planilha (etapa do lead, motivo de perda, status do pagamento).
  • Fazer follow-up diário dos leads abertos.
  • Garantir o básico do pós-venda: confirmação de sessão, checklist do cliente, alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Sinalizar gargalos para o marketing (objeções recorrentes, etapas que travam conversão).

Indicadores de sucesso (KPIs)

  • Tempo de primeira resposta: meta de 5 minutos em horário comercial.
  • Taxa de conversão Lead → Agendamento/Fechamento: meta de 15%
  • Follow-up diário: 90% de leads sem ficar “parado”.
  • Organização do funil: 100% dos leads com etapa definida e motivo de perda registrado.

Requisitos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com atendimento comercial (WhatsApp/DM) e fechamento .
  • Escrita objetiva e profissional (sem enrolação, sem “texto pronto genérico”).
  • Organização para trabalhar com funil, agenda e rotina de follow-up .
  • Conforto com metas e remuneração variável.
  • Equipamento e internet para trabalho (nos dias remotos).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com negócios de serviço/agenda (estética, saúde, fotografia, eventos).
  • Experiência com CRM (Canva, Notion, Trello, etc.).

Remuneração (PJ)

  • Fixo mensal: R$ 1.800,00
  • Comissão por meta de faturamento

Processo seletivo

  • Triagem pelo
  • Conversa rápida (15–20 min)
  • Teste prático simples (organização de funil + simulação de atendimento)
  • Entrevista final com sócios

Como se candidatar

Enviar (currículo/) + uma mensagem curta respondendo:

  • Qual sua experiência com atendimento e vendas por WhatsApp?
  • Qual resultado/indicador você já bateu em função comercial?

Unificamos os fluxos de criação e mídia, permitindo que marcas passem de um único criativo mestre para variações ilimitadas em minutos.

Nosso DNA: Como trabalhamos

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineering & GenAI (GCP)
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Operamos em duas frentes: a Plataforma Unificada de Pessoas, voltada a People Analytics e diagnóstico organizacional, e projetos de consultoria estratégica baseados em dados para grandes marcas globais. No lado de consultoria, construímos plataformas de analytics, modelos preditivos e camadas de IA generativa que alimentam decisões comerciais de alto nível, incluindo projetos para CPGs com presença em toda a América Latina.


Estamos contratando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, modelagem e IA em produção. O escopo é amplo por design: somos pequenos. Não há um engenheiro dedicado só a pipelines e outro só a modelagem. Você faz os dois, e precisa saber quando priorizar cada frente. O trabalho de consultoria é concreto: pegar dados de múltiplas fontes (sell-in, sell-out, P&L, market share, distribuição), estruturar pipelines que não quebrem toda semana, construir modelos que vão para produção de verdade, e desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa sobre esses dados. A plataforma interna de People Analytics caminha em paralelo, com modelagem de diagnóstico organizacional e integração de LLMs nos fluxos de produto.



Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e orquestrar pipelines de dados (BigQuery, GCP) com monitoramento real;
  • Harmonizar múltiplas fontes com nomenclaturas inconsistentes e atualizações diárias;
  • Construir modelos preditivos (XGBoost/LightGBM) e simuladores de cenário;
  • Colocar ML em produção: APIs (FastAPI), versionamento (MLflow, DVC), monitoramento de drift;
  • Desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa usando RAG, Vertex AI e LangChain;
  • Trabalhar direto com produto, tech lead e fundador — e eventualmente apresentar resultados para executivos de clientes globais.



Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Ciência da computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de software ou áreas afins;
  • Python sólido e SQL avançado;
  • GCP na prática: BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run;
  • Orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similar) — não só saber o que é, mas ter feito;
  • ML em produção de verdade, não apenas notebooks;
  • Familiaridade com LLMs, RAG e LangChain;
  • Experiência com Metabase ou ferramenta de BI equivalente para entrega de insights a stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica, documentação e contexto com clientes;
  • Perfil autônomo: sabe definir própria agenda dentro de objetivos claros.


Perfil valorizado: Quem já trabalhou com dados de negócio fora de grandes empresas de tecnologia — CPG, varejo, RH, mercado financeiro. A lógica de sell-in/sell-out, P&L e market share não é óbvia para todo mundo. Se você já navegou nesses contextos, vai se adaptar muito mais rápido.

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)

So… who the heck is Residence Supply?


I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary

How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

title: Over-the Counter (OTC) Sales Specialist
description:
Mackay Marine is a global marine electronics service company with more than 500 employees across 60 service depots in twenty-two (22) countries, including the America's, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Mackay offers competitive salaries plus overtime, and benefits such as health/dental insurance, holiday leave, meal and transportation vouchers are available as well.

Mackay is currently seeking a fulltime and experienced Marine Over the Counter (OTC) Specialist who is proficient in English, to work onsite at our Rio location. Individuals with the skills and qualifications outlined below are encouraged to apply.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB SUMMARY

The OTC Specialist is an onsite, non-managerial position which reports to the Managing Director for Brazil. The responsibilities of the OTC Specialist include but are not limited to communicating directly with our customers to answer questions concerning the availability, price, and use of merchandise as well as providing technical guidance, timely quotations, and comprehensive proposals. Will process over-the-counter transactions, special orders, phone-in and internet sales orders as well as inter-company transfers. Will support other team members, customers and company accounts with parts ordering and fulfillment to support our business.

Responsibilities will also include material handling and shipping/receiving of goods which includes physical lifting, handling of boxes, pallet jacks and may include activities on ladders, lifts, forklift, power tools, hand tools, carrying and moving of parts and equipment.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Acts as the point of contact for customer sales, service, and information requests to ensure that customer needs are fulfilled with speed and professionalism.
  • Assist in the research of basic technical issues on products and service. Collect symptoms of customer problems and facilitate repairs.
  • Assist with incoming sales prospects or customer calls when outside sales staff are out of the office.
  • Provide customer quotes, proposals, and will follow up in a timely manner.
  • Build the business by identifying revenue opportunities within the marine industry.
  • Assist with the shipping and receiving functions to help facilitate the trafficking and accountability for all materials received and delivered for customer orders, inventory, repairs, or for internal use.
  • Direct service requests the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain work area and stockroom in a clean and orderly fashion.
  • Read customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed and/or shipped using Mackay’s ERP system.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST SKILLS NEEDED:

  • Prior knowledge of Marine electronic equipment is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as product brochures, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, etc.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percentage.
  • Attention to detail and ability to organize materials effectively and efficiently.
  • Excellent customer service, communication (both oral and written), organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Two years of post-secondary education.
  • Electronics and/or marine background preferred.
  • Three years of inside or counter sales experience.
  • Good computer and Internet skills
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.


Applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.  Successful completion of a thorough background check will be required upon acceptance of an employment offer.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:

Role Overview

This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.

Role Overview


The Technical BIM Designer will support Ecotone’s technical drafting and modeling workflows by developing detailed Revit models, coordinating with engineering consultants, and implementing automation tools that improve production efficiency and model quality.


This role requires a strong understanding of construction documentation, engineering coordination, and fabrication-oriented modeling , along with the ability to develop computational workflows using Dynamo.


Candidates should be comfortable working in technically complex BIM environments where models directly support construction execution.



Requirements



Advanced Revit Expertise


Applicants must demonstrate strong professional proficiency in Revit modeling and documentation within architectural or construction environments.


Candidates should have significant experience with:


• Worksharing environments

• Complex family creation

• Advanced schedules and parameter management

• Maintaining model integrity across multidisciplinary teams



Dynamo Automation


Proven experience developing and maintaining Dynamo graphs to automate repetitive modeling and documentation workflows.


Candidates should be comfortable using Dynamo to:


• automate documentation tasks

• streamline modeling workflows

• enforce BIM standards

• reduce manual drafting work




Computational BIM Workflow Experience


Experience implementing data-driven BIM processes using Dynamo or similar tools to manage parameters, enforce standards, and perform automated quality control checks within large Revit models.




Design-Build Project Experience


Experience working in design-build or construction-integrated environments where BIM models directly support construction documentation, coordination, and fabrication.


Candidates should understand how digital models translate into construction outcomes.




Construction Documentation and Technical Detailing


Strong experience producing detailed construction documents in Revit.


Candidates should be comfortable developing:


• wall assemblies

• sections and details

• millwork and specialty architectural systems

• coordination details with engineering systems




MEP and Engineering Coordination

Candidates should be able to identify and resolve system conflicts directly within the BIM model.




Fabrication-Oriented Modeling


Experience producing highly detailed models that support:


• shop drawing development

• prefabrication workflows

• contractor installation and coordination




Buildability Awareness


Working knowledge of construction sequencing, material tolerances, installation constraints, and contractor workflows.


Models and drawings must reflect real-world construction logic, not conceptual architecture.




Professional Experience Requirement


This role is intended for experienced BIM professionals.


Applicants who are early in their careers, seeking training in Revit fundamentals, or looking for entry-level drafting roles will not be considered.

Python within Dynamo

Revit API Development

Why Work at Ecotone


Ecotone offers the opportunity to work on technically complex projects that integrate architecture, engineering coordination, fabrication, and construction.


Team members gain exposure to:


• advanced BIM workflows

• construction-integrated design environments

• highly specialized architectural systems

• real-world design-build problem solving

title: AWS Data Engineer
description:
Senior AWS Data Engineer - Python, SQL, Airflow

Location: Remote

Contract: 3 months initial


We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer with a strong background in Quality Assurance to join our client's team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive data quality strategy as they migrate their SQL databases to AWS. Your expertise in Python, SQL, and ETL frameworks like Airflow and dbt will ensure high-quality data pipelines and effective diagnosis of pipeline failures.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Quality Strategy Development: Design and implement a robust data quality strategy that addresses current challenges in SQL to AWS migration, ensuring data integrity and reliability throughout the process.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough quality assessments, validate data transformations, and ensure that all data quality metrics are met. Focus on identifying gaps and areas for improvement within existing ETL workflows.
  • Technical Proficiency: Utilize Python and SQL for extracting, transforming, and loading data. Implement automated testing frameworks (pytest) to validate data integrity and functionality across pipelines.
  • ETL Management: Leverage tools like Airflow and dbt to orchestrate data workflows and conduct regular checks to ensure pipeline performance. Identify and troubleshoot sources of failures.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Manage data storage and processing on AWS platforms, specifically with Redshift and S3. Optimize data storage solutions and ensure best practices for data security and accessibility.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Perform strong root-cause analysis to diagnose and resolve pipeline failures effectively. Document issues and fixes to improve future processes and communication with stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists and business analysts, to continuously improve data processes and quality metrics. Communicate findings clearly and provide recommendations to enhance system performance.
  • Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of data quality processes, testing outcomes, and any identified issues, along with their resolutions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Data Analyst, or in a similar role with a focus on QA.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and experience with data pipeline tools such as Airflow and dbt.
  • Familiarity with AWS services, particularly Redshift and S3.
  • Excellent English speaking and communication skills, with experience presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills with a keen ability to perform root-cause analysis and troubleshoot complex data issues.
  • Knowledge of data quality frameworks and methodologies is a plus.

title: \"Arquiteto de Cloud #996719\"
description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

title: Secretário(a)
description:
A Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviços de eletrônica marítima com sede nos EUA e mais de 500 funcionários em 60 centros de serviço em 22 países, incluindo as Américas, Europa, África e Ásia.

A Mackay oferece salários e benefícios competitivos, como seguro saúde/odontológico, férias anuais, vale-refeição e vale-transporte.

Resumo da Vaga de Secretário(a) de Centro de Serviço

O(A) Secretário(a) do Depósito é responsável por prestar apoio administrativo ao Diretor Geral do depósito no Brasil e encaminhar todas as questões e assuntos de Recursos Humanos à Matriz. As responsabilidades diárias incluem recepcionar visitantes, atender o telefone e responder e-mails, distribuir/enviar correspondências e/ou encomendas, inserir dados, emitir faturas, manter arquivos e criar/atualizar registros/documentos gerados por computador. Outras atribuições podem incluir verificar o estoque, solicitar mercadorias, precificar ordens de serviço, manter registros do almoxarifado e realizar o envio e recebimento de mercadorias.

As responsabilidades incluem, entre outras:

• Seguir sempre as políticas e os procedimentos da Mackay.

• Atuar como recepcionista, recepcionando visitantes e mantendo a área de recepção organizada.

• Atender telefonemas, e-mails, solicitações de clientes e consultas sobre estoque.

• Responder a perguntas dos departamentos de RH Corporativo, Folha de Pagamento, Contabilidade, Marketing, TI, SI e seus executivos. Encaminhar todas as questões ou assuntos relacionados à Folha de Pagamento e/ou Recursos Humanos para o RH Corporativo.

• Coordenar viagens e toda a documentação necessária para os técnicos.

• Manter e atualizar arquivos, registros internos, planilhas, relatórios e correspondências.

• Inserir dados no banco de dados Solomon, processar registros de consultas de vendas e ordens de serviço.

• Coordenar a distribuição de correspondências recebidas e enviadas, e gerenciar as necessidades de envio do depósito.

• Processar faturas semanais e enviá-las aos clientes de acordo com suas instruções.

• Processar relatórios de despesas, manter registros internos de férias/licença médica e relatórios diários de horas trabalhadas para engenheiros de serviço.

• Preparar folhas de ponto quinzenalmente para aprovação dos supervisores e enviar ao Departamento de Folha de Pagamento dentro do prazo estabelecido.

• Receber e processar pedidos; emitir equipamentos, peças e/ou suprimentos.

• Atribuir kits de serviço aos técnicos, verificar o estoque utilizado e devolvido e manter todos os registros relacionados.

• Verificar o estoque disponível e auxiliar nas transferências de estoque.

• Contatar fabricantes e distribuidores por telefone, fax e/ou e-mail para obter disponibilidade e preços de equipamentos, peças ou materiais necessários.

• Verificar se as mercadorias recebidas correspondem aos pedidos de compra e/ou requisições para garantir que estejam completas.

• Outras tarefas conforme designadas.

Qualificações para Secretário(a) de Depósito:

• Mais de 3 anos de experiência em suporte administrativo e de escritório.

• Mais de 1 ano de experiência em inventário (preferencial).

• Habilidade para realizar múltiplas tarefas e trabalhar bem sob pressão. • Domínio do Pacote Office, incluindo Excel e Word.

• Boa apresentação pessoal, pontualidade e discrição.

• Excelente comunicação telefônica, verbal e escrita.

• Excepcional capacidade de organização e comprometimento com o cumprimento de prazos.

• Carteira de habilitação válida e veículo próprio são requisitos.

Os candidatos devem ter autorização legal para trabalhar no Brasil e passar por uma rigorosa verificação de antecedentes.
